description:
Demand walks reachable clauses PLUS a trivial delta; codegen lowers ALL clauses.
The delta's gate excludes any clause that builds a value through steps, so a
Tuple/Const-returning clause that reachability under-approximates as dead can
still reach native lowering with a value that was never marked live.

The gate (src/compiler2/jobs/runtime_demand.rs:69-81):

    fn trivial_value_clause_ids(body: &LoweredBody, reachable: &[u32]) -> Vec<u32> {
        ...
        .filter(|clause_id| {
            let clause = &clauses[*clause_id as usize];
            let entry = &entries[clause.entry.as_u32() as usize];
            entry.steps.is_empty() && matches!(entry.tail, LoweredTail::Value { .. })
        })

`entry.steps.is_empty()` plus the bare-`Value` tail requirement together exclude
every clause that builds a tuple or const via steps.

The widening site and its rationale are intact
(jobs/runtime_demand.rs:1388-1400): "Codegen lowers every structural clause
regardless of the settled entry reachability, so a clause the type-level
reachability analysis under-approximates as dead can still reach native lowering
and crash when its return value was never marked live."

## Clauses that fall outside the gate today

    src/modules/runtime_library/list.fz:21  fn reduce(_list, {:halt, acc}, _reducer), do: {:halted, acc}
    src/modules/runtime_library/list.fz:53  fnp reduce_step(_list, {:halt, acc}, _reducer), do: {:halted, acc}
    src/modules/runtime_library/map.fz:33   fnp reduce(_map, _count, {:halt, acc}, _reducer), do: {:halted, acc}
    plus the {:suspended, acc, fn () -> ... end} clauses at list.fz:23/55 and map.fz:35

Each returns a CONSTRUCTED tuple, so each carries steps and a non-bare-Value
tail.

## Deliberately parked

No concrete crash reproduces it, and fz-6fr already failed to construct one for
the sibling case. This is a first-place-to-look note, not work to schedule. It
becomes actionable when a materialize-absent crash surfaces with a
Tuple/Const-returning pruned clause in the trace.

Verified accurate as filed -- every entity, line number and clause shape checks
out. `k22.8` in the title is history, not a live entity.
title: The trivial-clause widening gate excludes Tuple/Const-only clauses, leaving a latent demand-starvation gap
